item.title: Sol moves to GPT-6.1
item.summary: Murph now defaults to GPT-6.1 Sol. Existing OpenAI reminders and automations saved with GPT-6 Sol use GPT-6.1 Sol when they run.
item.details: Your schedules and explicit reasoning settings stay the same. You do not need to recreate reminders. Luna, Venice, and custom-provider routing keep their existing behavior.
